# Plot

## Regression Parameters

```{r plot-regression-parameters, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
tmp <- rbind(
  brms::posterior_samples(fit0, pars = "^b_|^sd_") %>%
    as.data.table() %>%
    melt(measure.vars = names(.)),
  brms::bayes_R2(fit0, summary = FALSE) %>%
    as.data.table() %>%
    melt(measure.vars = names(.))
) %>%
  # replace multiple `_`
  .[, variable := gsub("[_]{2,}", "_", variable)] %>%
  # recode R2 variables
  .[, variable := sub("R2(.*)", "model;\\1;r2", variable)] %>%
  # convert sd_code and sd_study
  .[, variable := sub("sd_code_(.*?)_Intercept", "sdcode_\\1_sdInterceptCode", variable)] %>%
  # make sure there are three parts in variable
  .[, variable := sub("(.*?)_(.*?)_(.*)", "\\1;\\2;\\3", variable)] %>%
  # split variable into multiple columns
  .[
    ,
    (c("level", "dv", "parameter")) := tstrsplit(
      variable,
      split = ";",
      fixed = TRUE
    )
  ] %>%
  # use a factor to rename variables
  .[,
    `:=`(
      dv = factor(
        dv,
        levels = c("pitch", "intensity", "speechrate", "jitter", "shimmer"),
        labels = c("Fundamental Frequency", "Voice Intensity", "Speech Rate", "Jitter", "Shimmer")
      ),
      parameter_desc = factor(
        parameter,
        levels = c(
          "sdInterceptCode", "r2",
          "abf_pm_z:stressed_pm_z", "abf_pmc_z:stressed_pmc_z",
          "abf_pm_z", "abf_pmc_z",
          "stressed_pm_z", "stressed_pmc_z",
          "panas_neg_pm_z", "panas_neg_pmc_z",
          "panas_pos_pm_z", "panas_pos_pmc_z",
          "sci_pm_z",
          "sun_vs_workwork",
          "workhour_pm_z", "workhour_pmc_z",
          "age_pm_z",
          "gendermale", "genderfemale"
        ),
        labels = c(
          "sd(Intercept)", "R^{2}",
          "EWS × Perceived Stress", "EWS × Perceived Stress",
          "EWS", "EWS",
          "Perceived Stress", "Perceived Stress",
          "Negative Mood", "Negative Mood",
          "Positive Mood", "Positive Mood",
          "Long-Term Stressors",
          "Sunday vs. Workday",
          "Working Hours", "Working Hours",
          "Age",
          "Male", "Female"
        )
      )
    )
  ]

# create single plots
p1 <- ggplot(
  tmp[level == "b" & parameter %in% c("gendermale", "genderfemale")],
  aes(x = parameter_desc, y = value)
) +
  ggdist::stat_pointinterval(
    .width = c(meta$ci_inner, meta$ci_outer),
    point_colour = "blue",
    point_size = 2,
    shape = 18,
    point_interval = ggdist::mean_qi
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(dv),
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Gender-Specific Intercepts"
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey",
      size = .2
    )
  )

p2 <- ggplot(
  tmp[level == "b" & !(parameter %in% c("gendermale", "genderfemale")) &
    endsWith(parameter, "pm_z")],
  aes(x = parameter_desc, y = value)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey") +
  ggdist::stat_pointinterval(
    .width = c(meta$ci_inner, meta$ci_outer),
    point_colour = "blue",
    point_size = 2,
    shape = 18,
    point_interval = ggdist::mean_qi
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(dv),
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Between-Participant Parameters (N = ", summary(fit0)$ngrps$code, ")")
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey",
      size = .2
    )
  )

p3 <- ggplot(
  tmp[level == "b" & !(parameter %in% c("gendermale", "genderfemale")) &
    !endsWith(parameter, "pm_z")],
  aes(x = parameter_desc, y = value)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey") +
  ggdist::stat_pointinterval(
    .width = c(meta$ci_inner, meta$ci_outer),
    point_colour = "blue",
    point_size = 2,
    shape = 18,
    point_interval = ggdist::mean_qi
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(dv),
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Within-Participant Parameters (", 
      summary(fit0)$nobs,
      " observations)"
    )
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey",
      size = .2
    )
  )

p4 <- ggplot(
  tmp[level %in% c("sdcode")],
  aes(x = parameter_desc, y = value)
) +
  ggdist::stat_pointinterval(
    .width = c(meta$ci_inner, meta$ci_outer),
    point_colour = "blue",
    point_size = 2,
    shape = 18,
    point_interval = ggdist::mean_qi
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(dv),
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Variance of Intercepts Between Participants"
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey",
      size = .2
    )

p5 <- ggplot(
  tmp[level == "model"],
  aes(x = parameter_desc, y = value)
) +
  ggdist::stat_pointinterval(
    .width = c(meta$ci_inner, meta$ci_outer),
    point_colour = "blue",
    point_size = 2,
    shape = 18,
    point_interval = ggdist::mean_qi
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(dv)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("0", ".25", ".5", ".75", "1")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_parse()) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Explained Variance"
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey",
      size = .2
    )
  )

# combine plots
ggpubr::ggarrange(
  p1, p2, p3, p4, p5,
  nrow = 5,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  heights = c(2, 4, 4, 1, 1)
)
```
